artworks.title: Andrea Doria
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper torso. He is turned slightly to the left, holding a long paddle-like object in his right hand. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, wavy hair, and a furrowed brow. He is dressed in a draped garment, possibly a toga, fastened with a brooch. The oval-framed image includes two cherubic figures above the man and illustrations of sea creatures at the bottom corners. The background is densely hatched, with a Latin inscription circling the oval border and a passage of text at the bottom.

artworks.title: John Doucher, French Divine
artworks.description: The image is a historical portrait of a man, seen from the upper body up. He is positioned facing slightly to his left. He wears a traditional cap and has a full beard and mustache with a slightly serious expression. His hair is short and mostly hidden. The man's clothing is formal and ornate with a fur-lined collar, high pleated shirt collar, and vertical buttons. The portrait is circular with an intricately inscribed frame including Latin text. The background is shaded with fine lines, creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: Rupert Duglass, Swedish General
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, including the shoulders and chest. The person is facing forward with a slight three-quarter turn to the left. He has a prominent nose, a neatly groomed mustache and goatee, and well-defined cheekbones. The person has long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders and wears a small cap. His attire includes a shirt with a wide lace collar under a cloak, possibly woven or fur-lined, draped over one shoulder. A visible armored vest with studs is seen beneath the cloak. The person is not holding any objects, and there is no visible jewelry. The portrait is set within an oval frame on a lined background, with a plaque beneath containing text, likely in Latin, surrounded by a textured, circular pattern.

artworks.title: Robert Duglass, Swedish General
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in an oval frame. The person is depicted from the chest up in a slightly turned position facing the right. His facial features include a long, straight nose, a prominent mustache, and wavy shoulder-length hair with curls at the ends. The individual is dressed in what appears to be a military or formal garment with riveted metal pieces, possibly armor, and a high, lace-trimmed collar. The background consists of closely spaced lines creating a textured backdrop. An inscription below the portrait reads "Robertus Duguay" with additional text in Latin.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with curly hair and a mustache dressed in Renaissance-style attire. They are posed facing forward with a composed expression, wearing a doublet with a ruffled lace collar, a chain, and a hand resting on a decorated helmet. A sword hangs from their belt. In the background is a hanging globe showing continents, a landscape with fields and a city, and an ornate coat of arms on the right.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man identified as Franciscus Dracus. He is depicted waist-up with a composed expression, featuring a mustache, beard, and wavy hair. He wears elaborate armor with intricate patterns and is surrounded by elements signifying exploration, such as a shield with a ship and hemispheres of a world map labeled with continents. In the background, there is Latin text and decorative elements. The setting is formal with a classical style.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man in a seated position, facing slightly to the left. His facial features include a trimmed beard and mustache, with a stern expression. His hair is styled with waves and curls sitting over his ears. He is wearing a detailed, high-collared garment with intricate patterns and puffed sleeves, adorned with straps and possibly a cloak draped over one shoulder. In his right hand, he is holding a globe. The setting appears to be an engraved illustration with a circle framing the man, containing the words "FRANCISCVS DRAKE MILES AVRATVS" around it. The background consists of a decorative, radial pattern behind the man, and the image is printed on a piece of paper with Latin text below and mirrored text visible on the back.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of an individual positioned slightly angled to the right, with a confident expression. The person has a mustache, goatee, wavy hair parted at the middle, and is wearing formal attire with a textured tunic, collared shirt with lace detailing, a draped sash, and a ruffled ribbon. They hold a globe in their left hand. The background includes a circle with decorative text and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image is an historical engraving of a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with short, wavy hair and a high hairline. He wears formal attire typical of the late 16th century, including a high-collared shirt under a coat adorned with a decorative sash across the chest. The man holds a sphere in his left hand, and his right hand appears to be gesturing near the edge of a globe in front of him. The globe is detailed with representations of different continents marked with letters. Surrounding the oval frame enclosing the portrait are nautical instruments, suggesting a maritime theme. In the background, there is an elaborate engraved scene with maritime decorations, including a detailed illustration of a ship within a circular frame beside the man. The illustration is bordered by Latin text and the year "1598" is at the top.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: A three-quarter-length portrait of a man facing slightly to the right is shown, holding a globe in his left hand. He has a thick, wavy hairstyle, a full mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. The man is wearing an ornate outfit with a patterned doublet and a sash draped over his shoulder. The background includes an emblem or coat of arms with an eagle, decorative elements, and evenly spaced horizontal lines. Below the portrait, the name "FRANCISCUS DRAKE" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after Jean Rabel
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an oval frame, angled slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features with a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, and a curled mustache. His hair is short and wavy, styled away from his face. The man wears ornate clothing with detailed embroidery, a breastplate with intricate patterns and a lion's face, and a shield displaying a naval battle scene. The background contains text in Latin and French, with engravings around the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after Jean Rabel
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man with curly hair, a full mustache, and a short beard, donning an ornate garment with a ruffled collar. A large shield with nautical themes is held by the man, with engraved details all around him.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after Jean Rabel
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an ornate outfit with curled mustache and short curly hair, standing in a frontal position with a slight turn to his left. He is surrounded by an oval frame with ships in the background and inscriptions. Text blocks below the portrait are written in Latin and French.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait engraving of a man within an oval frame. The man is turned slightly to his left, gazing forward, and his upper body, including the head and shoulders, is visible. He has curly hair and a full beard and mustache, with eyes that are attentive and a determined expression. He is wearing an ornate, high-collared outfit with intricately decorated armor. His attire suggests formality and rank, further accentuated by his confident pose. Resting on his shoulder is a shield featuring engravings of ships, swirling clouds, and waves. The background contains no additional scenes and remains part of the engraved framework displaying inscriptions around the edge of the oval.

artworks.title: Albrecht Durer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He has long, wavy hair, a full beard, and is dressed in an elaborate garment. He is holding a rectangular object with writing on it. The background is plain, with Latin inscriptions at the top and bottom of the image.

His facial features include a prominent nose and a deep-set eye looking straight ahead. He is wearing what looks like a fur collar. The background features a circular frame with etched details and inscriptions. The portrait appears to be an engraving.

His facial features include deep-set eyes and a rounded forehead. He wears a garment with a high collar, possibly a robe or coat with intricate patterns. The background features finely lined shading typical of an engraving. Below the image, there is a block of inscribed text in Latin, carved in a rectangular panel.

artworks.title: Edward I of England
artworks.description: The image shows a man with long hair, attired in medieval clothing and a crown, holding a sword upright in his right hand. He sits in a dignified posture against a plain backdrop with aged spots.

artworks.title: Edward II of England
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man from the upper half, facing forward with a serious expression. He has detailed facial features, curly shoulder-length hair, a crown with jewels, a neat beard, regal attire with fur trim, ornate embroidery, and a chain of office. The man holds a scepter and orb, symbols of authority, within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions. The background has a textured oval pattern.

artworks.title: Edward III of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a historical figure showing the upper half of their body. The person is seated and positioned with their body facing slightly to the right, while their gaze is directed forward. They have long, wavy hair and a full beard and mustache framing their face. They wear a crown adorned with ornate details and a protruding fleur-de-lis. Their attire includes a richly decorated robe with a high collar, featuring intricate designs and a large circular brooch on either side. They are depicted with a scepter in one hand and an orb in the other. The image is set within an oval frame surrounded by elaborate scrollwork and symbols, including the Latin inscription "EDWARDVS III. D.G. ANGLIAE ET FRANCIAE REX DOMINUS HIBERNIAE." The background is a textured field within the oval, with a coat of arms and other heraldic elements intricately integrated into the design. Beneath the portrait, there is a detailed description of the person's historical significance and achievements.

artworks.title: Edward IV of England
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated in a regal position. He has a calm expression with slightly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and medium-length wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He wears a crown embellished with ornate details and jewels, and his garments consist of richly decorated robes bordered with a fur trim, indicative of royalty. Around him is a decorative frame with heraldic symbols and English text. The man holds a scepter in his right hand and a globus cruciger in his left hand. The background is a textured pattern within an oval medallion, surrounded by elaborately designed insignia.

artworks.title: King Edward IV
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraved portrait of a historical figure, identified as King Edward III of England. He is depicted facing forward, holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left. The man's facial features are finely etched, with a straight nose, slightly parted lips, and long, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He wears a crown with intricate patterns and fleur-de-lis symbols. His robe is textured and lined with what appears to be fur. An ornate frame surrounds the figure, with scrollwork and Latin text naming him as Edward III. In the background are heraldic motifs such as a lion and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Edward V of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a young male figure from the waist up. He faces forward, holding a flower in his left hand. He has a smooth complexion and curly hair framing his face. He wears a crown, a richly decorated robe, and a fur-trimmed cloak. The engraving is set within a circular border with text indicating a title. The background features fine line work, heraldic symbols, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: King Edward V
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a young male figure within an oval frame. The subject has curly hair, a youthful face, and stares directly ahead. He wears a detailed garment and a crown, symbolizing royalty. In his right hand, he holds a flower. The background features scrollwork, shield motifs, and an inscription reading "EDVARDVS QVINTVS ANGLIE ET GALLIE REX DOMINVS HYBERNIAE." Additional decorative elements include florals and architecture. At the bottom, there is script mentioning Edward V.
